detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A dark fantasy idle game where the world keeps turning whether you're watching or not. Train, hunt, gather, and grow stronger through 17 deeply intertwined skills — even while you're away.

MASTER 17 SKILLS

From swinging steel as a Melee warrior to weaving spells as a Magic adept, every skill matters. Fish the cursed waters, mine the deep veins, fletch arrows that pierce the void, cremate the bones of fallen beasts, and cultivate ancient herbs. Each skill feeds into the next — a true living economy.

HUNT, FORGE, ASCEND

Slay monsters across crumbling kingdoms and forgotten ruins. Loot bones, hides, and rare materials. Forge them into legendary gear at the smithy, the alchemy bench, the fletching table. Every drop matters. Every upgrade brings you closer to facing the Void.

LOYAL COMPANIONS

Unlock 17 unique pets — one for every skill mastered. Steelfang the wolf pup, Sharpeye the hawk, Whisper the spectral familiar, Sprout the seedling, and many more. Each grants permanent bonuses to their domain.

A LIVING WORLD

Random encounters, traveling merchants, town criers, whispered subplots, and shadowy strangers fill the world while you play. The realm has stories — listen, and they'll find you.

IDLE AT YOUR OWN PACE

Eldara respects your time. Set your activity, walk away, come back stronger. No subscriptions. No timers behind paywalls. No pay-to-win. Just you, the realm, and the long climb to mastery.

FEATURES

  • 17 fully-featured skills with unique passives and milestones

  • 17 collectible pets with permanent bonuses

  • Hundreds of items, recipes, and crafting paths

  • Dynamic chat events, random encounters, and unfolding subplots

  • Deep Codex tracking every item, monster, and secret you discover

  • Offline progress that respects your time

  • One-time purchase. No microtransactions. Ever.

The realm is waiting. Will you answer its call?
